text: Flexion announced a Sim2Real research collaboration with Niantic Spatial and NVIDIA.
Holistic Fusion was published in IEEE Transactions on Robotics.
Flexion released Reflect v1.0, our work on generalizable, long-horizon humanoid autonomy.
Flexion raised a USD 50M Series A, led by DST Global Partners with participation from NVentures (NVIDIA), Prosus Ventures, redalpine and Moonfire.
Flexion released Reflect v0, our first step towards generalizable robot autonomy.
Started our journey at Flexion Robotics together with Nikita Rudin, David Hoeller and Fabian Tischhauser.
I defended my PhD at ETH Zurich: Towards Robust and Flexible Robot State and Motion Estimation through Optimization and Learning.
Raised our seed round of USD 7.35M.
